verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly claim most payments arrive in under 20 seconds and cover 40+ currencies/160+ countries, directly supporting the story. However, community evidence shows operational disruptions (account detail changes, account blocks) that undermine reliability of the payment experience, and there's no independent corroboration of actual speed claims. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the under-a-minute speed claim, and resolution of community reliability concerns.
